audience: merchants and fulfilment teams who ship parcels with carriers through Webshipper

useCases.title: Find orders waiting for dispatch
useCases.text: List the orders by status, channel or creation date. Open one order to read its delivery address and lines.

useCases.title: Track a parcel
useCases.text: List the shipments of an order, then list the tracking events of one shipment to see each carrier scan.

useCases.title: Check the connected carriers and channels
useCases.text: List the carriers connected to the account, and the order channels that send orders to Webshipper.

useCases.title: Create a shipping order from a sale
useCases.text: Create an order with a delivery address and lines. Use a new ext_ref each time, then find the order by that reference. It can start shipping work.
